scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma || echo 'Prisma generate failed automatically — once your network can reach binaries.prisma.sh, run: pnpm db:generate'
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @peerconnect/database build && pnpm --filter @peerconnect/validation build && pnpm --filter @peerconnect/types build
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.start: pnpm --filter api start & pnpm --filter web start
